ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent cases of Medicaid fraud and follow the money to see where it leads
questions: How much money is being lost to Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover a large-scale pattern of fraud and corruption, and I would like to use data analysis and public records to follow the money and see where it leads
